cathedralSite.limitations: Plan-aligned reconstruction, NOT perfect on every side. Street terrain remains flat; relative heights, tread counts and profiles, lamp offsets, railing pattern and crypt portal profile are approximate. Ramp and stairs are visual/solid obstacles, not elevation-aware navigation. Current construction and temporary cafe fixtures are omitted.

paving: Municipal Senaatintori Aukiot polygons, preserving material segmentation and holes; stone appearance is representative, not a site scan
